QuestInfo.name: I'll Show You How to Hunt
QuestInfo.0: Get some information on hunting from #b#p1102005##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1102005# briefly explained the basics of hunting and asked that you hunt #r#o100120##ks, the weakest creatures in Ereve, as a test. He says you can attack by pressing the #bCtrl key#k, so let's try it out!
QuestInfo.2: You have come back after hunting the #o0100120#s. #p1102005# says you can meet his brother #p1102006# if you continue to your left.

mob.0: You haven't been able to eliminate #r1 #o100120##k yet? Don't be scared. Move near the #o0100120# just close enough so that your weapon touches the monster and press the #bCtrl key#k a few times. That's all it takes! You can do it!
